title: Ideogram 2.0: The New King of Typography
description: Ideogram 2.0 is currently the most accurate AI for rendering text. Great for cafe logos, event posters, and brand design.

prompt.main: modern minimalist cafe logo design, geometric coffee bean icon, text "BREW LAB" in bold sans-serif typography below the icon, monochromatic black and white color scheme, vector graphic style, clean lines, professional branding

explained.why: Currently the most accurate model for rendering text (far better than MJ/SD).
Specify vector style to avoid an AI "photo" feel.

tutorial.intro: Ideogram 2.0 is the best AI tool right now for logo / poster / text-heavy design.
steps: Use Ideogram 2.0: it renders text ~90% more accurately than MJ/SD.
Wrap text in quotes: "BREW LAB" 鈥?tells the model this is text to render.
Lock the style: modern minimalist / vintage / art deco / hand-lettered 鈥?pick one.
Describe the icon: geometric coffee bean icon 鈥?even for logos, describe the icon.
Lock the palette: monochromatic black and white 鈥?keep it simple to avoid color noise.
tutorial.tips: Ideogram 2.0 is the only model that reliably renders Chinese and English text. For Chinese logos, just type the brand name in quotes.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1 text is better than before but still misspells. Try: "logo design saying BREW LAB --v 6.1"
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SD struggles with text. Inpaint afterwards to fix.
crossModel.flux: Flux text is OK but behind Ideogram.
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 鍗虫ⅵ Chinese logo rendering is solid: "鐜颁唬绠€绾﹀挅鍟″簵 logo, BREW LAB, 鍑犱綍鍜栧暋璞嗗浘鏍嘰

faq.q: How to fix MJ misspelling text?
faq.a: Switch to Ideogram 2.0, or inpaint to fix the letters afterwards.

faq.q: Which AI is best for logo design?
faq.a: Ideogram 2.0 > Flux > MJ v6.1. SD is good if you have a tuned LoRA.
